173: static bk_err_t pm_cp0_mailbox_send_data(uint32_t cmd, uint32_t param1,uint32_t param2,uint32_t param3)
174: {
175: 	mb_chnl_cmd_t mb_cmd = {0};
176: 	int ret              = 0;
177: 	uint8_t  retry_count = 0;
178: 	bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_MAILBOX,0,0);
179: 	mb_cmd.hdr.cmd = cmd;

188: 		rtos_delay_milliseconds(2);
189:         if(retry_count > 5)
190:         {

192: 			bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_MAILBOX,1,0);
193:             return ret;
194:         }
195: 	}
196: 	bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_MAILBOX,1,0);
197: 	return BK_OK;
198: }

378: static bk_err_t pm_openvela_clock_validate(void)
379: {
380: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
381: 	uint32_t clk = sys_drv_all_modules_clk_div_get(CLK_DIV_REG0);
382: 	uint32_t required = bk_pm_vdddig_required_get(PM_CPU_FRQ_480M);
383: 
384: 	if (bk_pm_module_current_cpu_freq_get(PM_DEV_ID_CPU1) != PM_CPU_FRQ_480M ||
385: 		bk_pm_current_max_cpu_freq_get() != PM_CPU_FRQ_480M ||
386: 		((clk >> 4) & 0x3) != 0x3 || ((clk >> 0) & 0xf) != 0x0 ||
387: 		((clk >> 6) & 0x1) != 0x1 ||
388: 		sys_drv_cpu_clk_div_get(0) != 0 ||
389: 		sys_drv_cpu_clk_div_get(1) != 1 ||
390: 		sys_drv_cpu_clk_div_get(2) != 1 ||
391: 		sys_hal_vdddig_h_vol_get() < required)
392: 	{
393: 		LOGE("OpenVela clock invalid slot/max=%d/%d clk=0x%x "
394: 			"speed=%d/%d/%d vdddig=0x%x need=0x%x\r\n",
395: 			bk_pm_module_current_cpu_freq_get(PM_DEV_ID_CPU1),
396: 			bk_pm_current_max_cpu_freq_get(), clk,
397: 			sys_drv_cpu_clk_div_get(0), sys_drv_cpu_clk_div_get(1),
398: 			sys_drv_cpu_clk_div_get(2), sys_hal_vdddig_h_vol_get(), required);
399: 		return BK_FAIL;
400: 	}
401: #if CONFIG_RX_OPTIMIZE
402: 	if (sys_hal_vddd_h_vol_get() < 0x7)
403: 	{
404: 		LOGE("OpenVela VDDD invalid: 0x%x\r\n",
405: 			sys_hal_vddd_h_vol_get());
406: 		return BK_FAIL;
407: 	}
408: #endif
409: #endif
410: 	return BK_OK;
411: }

413: static void pm_openvela_boot_rollback(void)
414: {
415: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
416: 	bk_err_t first = BK_OK;
417: 	bk_err_t ret;
418: 
419: 	ap_console_bridge_link_down();
420: #if CONFIG_MAILBOX
421: 	mb_ipc_reset_notify(1, 0);
422: #endif
423: 	ret = bk_cpu2_hold_reset();
424: 	pm_record_first_error(&first, ret);
425: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
426: 		LOGE("rollback: CPU2 reset hold failed: %d\r\n", ret);
427: 	ret = bk_cpu1_hold_reset();
428: 	pm_record_first_error(&first, ret);
429: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
430: 		LOGE("rollback: CPU1 reset hold failed: %d\r\n", ret);
431: 	ret = bk_pm_module_vote_psram_ctrl(PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_NAME_OPENVELA,
432: 		PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
433: 	pm_record_first_error(&first, ret);
434: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
435: 		LOGE("rollback: OpenVela PSRAM release failed: %d\r\n", ret);
436: 	ret = bk_pm_openvela_cpu2_power_hold(PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
437: 	pm_record_first_error(&first, ret);
438: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
439: 		LOGE("rollback: CPU2 power release failed: %d\r\n", ret);
440: 	ret = bk_pm_module_vote_power_ctrl(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1,
441: 		PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
442: 	pm_record_first_error(&first, ret);
443: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
444: 		LOGE("rollback: CPU1 power release failed: %d\r\n", ret);
445: 	if (s_pm_openvela_freq_held)
446: 	{
447: 		ret = bk_pm_module_vote_cpu_freq(PM_DEV_ID_CPU1, PM_CPU_FRQ_DEFAULT);
448: 		pm_record_first_error(&first, ret);
449: 		if (ret == BK_OK)
450: 			s_pm_openvela_freq_held = false;
451: 		else
452: 			LOGE("rollback: frequency release failed: %d\r\n", ret);
453: 	}
454: 	if (s_pm_openvela_cpu1_sleep_held)
455: 	{
456: 		ret = bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1, 1, 0);
457: 		pm_record_first_error(&first, ret);
458: 		if (ret == BK_OK)
459: 			s_pm_openvela_cpu1_sleep_held = false;
460: 		else
461: 			LOGE("rollback: CPU1 sleep vote restore failed: %d\r\n", ret);
462: 	}
463: 	s_pm_cp1_boot_ready = PM_MAILBOX_COMMUNICATION_INIT;
464: 	s_pm_openvela_boot_stage = 0;
465: 	s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state = 0;
466: 	s_pm_cp1_closing = 0;
467: 	s_pm_cp1_closing_module = PM_BOOT_CP1_MODULE_NAME_MAX;
468: 	if (first != BK_OK)
469: 		LOGE("OpenVela rollback completed with error: %d\r\n", first);
470: #else
471: 	ap_console_bridge_link_down();
472: #if CONFIG_MAILBOX
473: 	mb_ipc_reset_notify(1, 0);
474: #endif
475: 	(void)bk_cpu1_hold_reset();
476: 	(void)bk_pm_module_vote_power_ctrl(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1,
477: 		PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
478: #if CONFIG_PM_AP_POWERDOWN_WHEN_LV
479: 	(void)bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1, 1, 0);
480: #endif
481: #endif
482: }

484: bk_err_t bk_pm_openvela_ready_handle(uint32_t ready, int32_t error)
485: {
486: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
487: 	bk_err_t ret = BK_OK;
488: 	uint32_t owner = 0x1U << PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_NAME_OPENVELA;
489: 
490: 	if (ready == 0)
491: 	{
492: 		if (error >= 0)
493: 			LOGE("OpenVela abort missing negative errno: %d\r\n", error);
494: 		else
495: 			LOGE("OpenVela boot aborted by AP: %d\r\n", error);
496: 		s_pm_openvela_boot_error = error < 0 ? error : BK_FAIL;
497: 		pm_openvela_boot_rollback();
498: 		return error < 0 ? error : BK_FAIL;
499: 	}
500: 	if (ready != 1)
501: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
502: 	if (s_pm_openvela_boot_stage != 5 ||
503: 		sys_drv_module_power_state_get(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1) !=
504: 			PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON ||
505: 		sys_drv_module_power_state_get(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU2) !=
506: 			PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON ||
507: 		!s_pm_openvela_cpu2_held || !(s_pm_psram_ctrl_state & owner))
508: 	{
509: 		LOGE("OpenVela commit state invalid stage=%d cpu=%d/%d hold=%d psram=0x%x\r\n",
510: 			s_pm_openvela_boot_stage,
511: 			sys_drv_module_power_state_get(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1),
512: 			sys_drv_module_power_state_get(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU2),
513: 			s_pm_openvela_cpu2_held, s_pm_psram_ctrl_state);
514: 		ret = BK_ERR_STATE;
515: 	}
516: 	if (ret == BK_OK)
517: 		ret = pm_openvela_clock_validate();
518: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
519: 	{
520: 		s_pm_openvela_boot_error = ret;
521: 		return ret;
522: 	}
523: 	s_pm_openvela_boot_stage = 6;
524: 	ap_console_bridge_ready_update(AP_BRIDGE_READY_PWC, true);
525: 	(void)bk_pm_openvela_diag_dump();
526: 	return BK_OK;
527: #else
528: 	(void)ready;
529: 	(void)error;
530: 	return BK_ERR_NOT_SUPPORT;
531: #endif
532: }

534: static bk_err_t pm_module_bootup_cpu1(pm_power_module_name_e module)
535: {
536: 	uint64_t previous_tick = 0;
537: 	uint64_t current_tick   = 0;
538: 	bk_err_t ret;
539: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
540: 	if (module == PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1 &&
541: 		PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF != sys_drv_module_power_state_get(module))
542: 	{
543: 		LOGE("CPU1 powered before OpenVela lifecycle transaction\r\n");
544: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
545: 	}
546: #endif
547: 	if(PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF == sys_drv_module_power_state_get(module))
548: 	{
549: 		if(module == PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1)
550: 		{
551: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
552: 			s_pm_openvela_boot_error = BK_OK;
553: 			ret = bk_pm_module_vote_cpu_freq(PM_DEV_ID_CPU1, PM_CPU_FRQ_480M);
554: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
555: 				return ret;
556: 			s_pm_openvela_freq_held = true;
557: 			s_pm_openvela_boot_stage = 1;
558: 			ret = pm_openvela_clock_validate();
559: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
560: 				goto rollback;
561: 			ret = bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1, 0, 0);
562: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
563: 				goto rollback;
564: 			s_pm_openvela_cpu1_sleep_held = true;
565: 			if (!bk_cpu2_reset_is_held())
566: 			{
567: 				LOGE("CPU2 is not reset-held ctrl=0x%x run=0x%x\r\n",
568: 					bk_cpu2_ctrl_get(), bk_cpu_run_status_get());
569: 				ret = BK_ERR_STATE;
570: 				goto rollback;
571: 			}
572: 			ret = bk_pm_openvela_cpu2_power_hold(PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON);
573: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
574: 				goto rollback;
575: 			s_pm_openvela_boot_stage = 2;
576: #else
577: #if CONFIG_PM_AP_POWERDOWN_WHEN_LV
578: 			ret = bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1, 0, 0);
579: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
580: 				return ret;
581: #endif
582: #endif
583: 			ret = bk_pm_module_vote_power_ctrl(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1,
584: 				PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON);
585: 			if (ret != BK_OK ||
586: 				sys_drv_module_power_state_get(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1) !=
587: 				PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON)
588: 			{
589: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
590: 				if (sys_drv_module_power_state_get(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1) ==
591: 					PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON)
592: 					s_pm_openvela_boot_stage = 3;
593: #endif
594: 				ret = ret == BK_OK ? BK_FAIL : ret;

1145: uint32_t bk_pm_vdddig_required_get(pm_cpu_freq_e cpu_freq)

1152: 		if (map[i].cpu_freq == cpu_freq)
1153: 		{
1154: 			target = map[i].vdddig;

1160: 		target = PM_VDDDIG_095;

1162: 		target < PM_VDDDIG_095)

118: int up_cpu_start(int cpu)

121:   uint32_t control;

126:       return -EINVAL;
127:     }
128: 
129:   status = getreg32(BK7258_CPU_RUN_STATUS);
130:   if ((status & BK7258_CPU_STATUS_CPU2_POWER_DOWN) != 0 ||
131:       !bk7258_mbox_smp_ready())
132:     {
133:       syslog(LOG_ERR, "CPU2 prerequisite failed: status=%08lx mbox=%u\n",
134:              (unsigned long)status, bk7258_mbox_smp_ready());
135:       PANIC();
136:     }
137: 
138:   bk7258_cpu2_hold_reset();
139:   control = getreg32(BK7258_CPU2_CONTROL);
140:   status = getreg32(BK7258_CPU_RUN_STATUS);
141:   if ((control & BK7258_CPU2_RESET_RELEASE) != 0 ||
142:       (status & BK7258_CPU_STATUS_CPU2_RESET) != 0)
143:     {
144:       syslog(LOG_ERR, "CPU2 reset hold failed: ctrl=%08lx status=%08lx\n",
145:              (unsigned long)control, (unsigned long)status);
146:       PANIC();
147:     }
148: 
149:   atomic_set(&g_cpu2_online, 0);
150:   bk7258_smp_prepare_boot();
151:   putreg32(0, BK7258_CPU2_IRQ_EN0);
152:   putreg32(0, BK7258_CPU2_IRQ_EN1);
153:   modifyreg32(BK7258_CPU2_CONTROL, BK7258_CPU2_OFFSET_MASK,
154:               BK7258_CPU2_RXEVT_SEL |
155:               (((uintptr_t)__secondary_vectors_start >> 8) <<
156:                BK7258_CPU2_OFFSET_SHIFT));
157:   UP_DMB();
158:   UP_DSB();
159:   bk7258_cpu2_release_reset();
160: 
161:   started = clock_systime_ticks();
162:   while (atomic_read_acquire(&g_cpu2_online) == 0 ||
163:          !bk7258_smp_boot_test_complete())
164:     {
165:       if (atomic_read_acquire(&g_cpu2_online) != 0 &&
166:           bk7258_smp_boot_ping(1) == OK)
167:         {
168:           while (!bk7258_smp_boot_test_complete() &&
169:                  clock_systime_ticks() - started <
170:                    BK7258_CPU2_ONLINE_TIMEOUT)
171:             {
172:               __asm__ volatile("wfe");
173:             }
174:         }
175: 
176:       if (clock_systime_ticks() - started >= BK7258_CPU2_ONLINE_TIMEOUT)

178:           bk7258_cpu2_hold_reset();
179:           syslog(LOG_ERR,

113: static int ipc_heartbeat_timeout(void)
114: {
115: 	u32   cur_time;
116: 
117: 	cur_time = (u32)rtos_get_time();
118: 
119: 	if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
120: 	{
121: 		return 0;
122: 	}
123: 	if((cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING) || (cpu_x_dump != 0))
124: 	{
125: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = cur_time;
126: 		return 0;
127: 	}
128: 
129: 	if(cur_time >= cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp)
130: 	{
131: 		cur_time -= cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp;
132: 	}
133: 	else
134: 	{
135: 		cur_time += (~(cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp)) + 1;  // wrap around.
136: 	}
137: 
138: 	if(cur_time < HB_TIMEOUT_MS)
139: 	{
140: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
141: 		return 0;
142: 	}
143: 
144: 	if (bk_pm_module_lv_sleep_state_get(PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT))
145: 	{
146: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
147: 		bk_pm_module_lv_sleep_state_clear(PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT);
148: 		return 0;
149: 	}
150: 
151: 	if(s_mb_ipc_work_state == MB_IPC_EXIT_LV)
152: 	{
153: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
154: 		s_mb_ipc_work_state = MB_IPC_WORKING;
155: 		return 0;
156: 	}
157: 
158: 	return 1;
159: }

219: static void mb_ipc_task( void *para )
220: {
221: 	bk_err_t	ret_val;
222: 	u32    events;
223: 	u32    check_time = BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER;
224: 
225: 	mb_ipc_init_lv_callback();
226: 
227: 	ret_val = rtos_init_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event);
228: 
229: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
230: 	{
231: 		rtos_delete_thread(NULL);
232: 		return;
233: 	}
234: 
235: 	while(1)
236: 	{
237: 		events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_ALL_FLAGS, true, check_time);
238: 
239: 		if(events == 0)
240: 		{
241: 			// timeout, so check heartbeat.
242: 			events = MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG;
243: 		}
244: 
245: 		if(events & MB_IPC_STOP_CORE_FLAG)  // process this event at first!!!!
246: 		{
247: 			if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
248: 			{
249: 				events = 0;  // clear all events.
250: 			}
251: 		}
252: 
253: 		if(events & MB_IPC_START_CORE_FLAG)
254: 		{
255: 			u8   retry_cnt = 0;
256: 
257: 			while(cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING)
258: 			{
259: 				ipc_heartbeat_timeout();
260: 
261: 				if(events & MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG)
262: 				{
263: 					if(cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING)
264: 					{
265: 						cpu_x_state = CORE_POWER_ON;
266: 						break;  // cpu1 power on.
267: 					}
268: 				}
269: 				else
270: 				{
271: 					if( retry_cnt > 3)
272: 					{
273: 						BK_DUMP_OUT("IPC retry to start core%d, retry_cnt:%d\r\n", cpu_x_id, retry_cnt);
274: 						// restart_cpu_x();
275: 						break;
276: 					}
277: 					else
278: 					{
279: 						events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG, true, 2000);//2s
280: 					}
281: 				}
282: 
283: 				retry_cnt++;
284: 			}
285: 
286: 			// discard this event when not in CORE_STARTING state.
287: 		}
288: 
289: 		if(events & MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG)
290: 		{
291: 			if(ipc_heartbeat_timeout())
292: 			{
293: 				BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "IPC[%d]heartbeat timeout %d,%d\r\n",cpu_x_id,cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp,(u32)rtos_get_time());
294: 				/*when cpu1 heartbeat timeout, then system reboot*/
295: 				cpu_x_heartbeat_timeout = 1;
296: 				ap_console_bridge_link_down();
297: 				BK_ASSERT(false);
298: 			}
299: 		}
300: 
301: 		if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
302: 		{
303: 			check_time = BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER;
304: 		}
305: 		else
306: 		{
307: 			check_time = HB_TIMEOUT_MS;
308: 		}
309: 	}
310: }

548: static bool valid_ack_header(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
549:                              const struct active_transaction *active)
550: {
551:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
552: 
553:   return active->busy && control == BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX &&
554:          bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) ==
555:            bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message) &&
556:          bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) ==
557:            bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message) &&
558:          bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) ==
559:            bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message);
560: }

562: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
563: {
564:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
565:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
566:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;
567: }

569: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
570: {
571:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
572:   struct active_transaction *active;
573:   bool replay;
574:   int result;
575: 
576:   active = busy_probe();
577:   if (active == NULL)
578:     {
579:       active = &g_active;
580:     }
581: 
582:   if (!valid_ack_header(message, active))
583:     {
584:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
585:       return;
586:     }
587: 
588:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
589:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
590:     {
591:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
592: 
593:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
594:       return;
595:     }
596: 
597:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
598:     {
599:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
600:       return;
601:     }
602: 
603:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
604:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
605: 
606:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
607:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
608:     {
609:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
610:     }
611: 
612:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
613:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
614:   if (replay)
615:     {
616:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
617:       unsigned int i;
618: 
619:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
620:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
621:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
622:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
623:        */
624: 
625:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
626:       g_active.quarantine = false;
627:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
628:         {
629:           if (i != replay_index)
630:             {
631:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
632:             }
633:         }
634: 
635:       select_recovery_epoch();
636:       (void)dispatch_locked();
637:       return;
638:     }
639: 
640:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
641: 
642:   if (active == &epoch->probe)
643:     {
644:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
645:         {
646:           release_recovery_slots();
647:           g_recovery_index = 0;
648:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
649:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
650:         }
651:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
652:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
653:         {
654:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
655:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
656:            */
657:         }
658:       else
659:         {
660:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
661:           epoch->probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
662:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
663:         }
664:     }
665: 
666:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
667:            result < 0)
668:     {
669:       begin_abort(result);
670:     }
671: 
672:   (void)dispatch_locked();
673: }

675: static int handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
676: {
677:   struct ack_slot *slot;
678:   unsigned int rx_index;
679:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
680:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
681:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
682:   uint8_t state = 0;
683:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
684: 
685:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
686:     {
687:       slot = alloc_ack_slot();
688:       if (slot == NULL)
689:         {
690:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
691:           return -EAGAIN;
692:         }
693:     }
694:   else
695:     {
696:       slot = NULL;
697:     }
698: 
699:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
700:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
701:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
702:     {
703:       g_stats.bad_header++;
704:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
705:     }
706:   else if ((rx_index = rx_channel_index(channel)) < MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT &&
707:            g_rx_callbacks[rx_index] != NULL)
708:     {
709:       ret = g_rx_callbacks[rx_index](message, &ack_flags,
710:                                       g_rx_args[rx_index]);
711:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
712:         {
713:           if (slot != NULL)
714:             {
715:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
716:             }
717: 
718:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
719:           return -EAGAIN;
720:         }
721:       else if (ret < 0)
722:         {
723:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
724:         }
725:     }
726:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
727:     {
728:       g_pwc_rx(message);
729:       ret = OK;
730:     }
731:   else
732:     {
733:       g_stats.unsupported++;
734:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
735:     }
736: 
737:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) != 0)
738:     {
739:       return OK;
740:     }
741: 
742:   memset(&slot->message, 0, sizeof(slot->message));
743:   slot->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
744:     bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message), state, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX,
745:     bk7258_mb_header_seq(message), channel);
746:   slot->message.payload_address = ack_flags;
747: 
748:   if (ack_slots_used() >= MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
749:     {
750:       g_probe_requested = true;
751:     }
752: 
753:   (void)dispatch_locked();
754:   return OK;
755: }

757: static int mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
758: {

763:   g_stats.rx++;
764:   control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
765: 
766:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET) != 0)
767:     {
768:       if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 ||
769:           (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) & 0xf0u) != 0x40u ||
770:           (control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0)
771:         {
772:           g_stats.bad_header++;
773:         }

775:         {
776:           g_stats.resets++;
777:           g_peer_reset_generation++;
778:           bk7258_mbox_discard_deferred();

780:         }
781:     }
782:   else if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0)
783:     {
784:       handle_ack(message);
785:     }

787:     {
788:       int ret = handle_command(message);

791:         {
792:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
793:           return ret;
794:         }
795:     }
796: 
797:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
798:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
799:   return OK;
